senses.gloss: f. (עָתַר to dig, stir; trnsf. to entreat, beseech; cmp. פָּגַע, פָּצַר) entreaty, being entreated, use of the root עתר.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 25:21">Gen. XXV, 21</cite>; a.
<cite ref="II Samuel 21:14">II Sam. XXI, 14</cite>) <he>מה ע׳ שנאמר להלן תאומים אף ע׳ וכ׳</he> as ‘being entreated’ there refers to the grant of twins, so it does here &c. (double fertility).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:9">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>שמע עֲתִירָתֵינוּ</he> hear our prayer; a. e.
